Cityblock Health Expands Long-Term Services and Supports (LTSS) Offering to Transform Care for Medicaid and Dually Eligible Members with Complex Needs

product_launches.description: Cityblock Health expanded its Long-Term Services and Supports solution, integrating AI-enabled capabilities and scaling the program across all states where it operates to better serve Medicaid and dually eligible members with complex needs.

overview_description.description: Cityblock Health is a tech-driven provider for communities with complex needs it focuses on investing upstream in highly personalized, prevention-oriented health and social care to ultimately drive down costs and improve outcomes. Its technology enables scale by bringing together practical information, coordination, and communication for its members and care teams. During COVID-19, Cityblock created a model to help organizations determine which of their members are at high risk of COVID-19.

about_short_description.short_description: Cityblock Health is a tech-driven healthcare provider that offers comprehensive and personalised care for underserved communities.

identifier.value: Integrated Medical, Mental, and Social Care

product.name: Integrated Medical, Mental, and Social Care
product.description: A coordinated care model combining medical services, mental health support, and social care assistance for Medicaid and Medicare members with complex needs.

product.name: Primary Care
product.description: Preventive and ongoing medical care, including health assessments, treatment, chronic-condition support, and answers to members’ health questions.

product.name: Mental Health
product.description: Mental health and behavioral health support, including therapy, crisis assistance, and treatment for substance use and addiction-related conditions.

product.name: Social Care Services
product.description: Assistance connecting members with community resources for needs such as housing, food, childcare, employment, transportation, and legal aid.

product.name: Urgent Care
product.description: 24/7 phone and virtual access to licensed healthcare providers, with in-home urgent care for eligible situations where permitted.

product.name: Hospital to Home
product.description: Post-discharge support that helps members transition from a hospital to home through nursing follow-up, medication coordination, appointments, and resource assistance.
